title: Subscription console
idea: Subscription console: Plan entitlements and billing events stay distinct from usage
audience: People who need to manage plan within a dashboard surface.
avoidWhen: The product promises unsupported unlimited service
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic ledger layout through its manage plan priority and explicit commitment contract: Cancellation and refund states require provider confirmation
navigation: Subscription console keeps the current manage plan context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Plan entitlements and billing events stay distinct from usage
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to manage plan; commercial access requires transparent state
composition.priority: Cancellation and refund states require provider confirmation

imagery.role: Support the actual manage plan context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep renewal cancellation and usage consequences readable
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the subscription console structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no manage plan content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Cancellation and refund states require provider confirmation
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized manage plan content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Cancellation and refund states require provider confirmation
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active manage plan context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
